selection: Exact frozen shard/name/dtype/shape/digest selection, filtered before stock lazy safetensors get_tensor; preserve upstream expert filtering. Reject duplicate/missing/wrong-shard/shape/dtype/source identities. No global loader mutation, eager or prefetch path.
staging: One persistent pinned uint8 buffer at most 8 MiB and one reusable completion event. Complete each transfer before buffer reuse. One owned CUDA temporary per synchronous consume callback; callback must not retain it or its views. Synchronize callback use before release. Account for destination overlap.
acceptance: CPU source digest equals frozen tensor digest and chunked device readback digest for every selected tensor, including scalars, mixed dtypes and short final chunks. Actual loader/finalizer storage and byte checks are separately required in fresh contained processes at full geometry.
default: Uninstalled evidence helper, explicit enabled=True startup selection only; disabled call performs no imports or filesystem work.
limits: Does not make internal pointer-table copies pinned, guarantee zero filesystem readahead, qualify production performance, model fidelity or full-load memory fit. Diagnostics are confined to evidence loading; no serving token path is modified.
